finalText:
Migration's done. Twelve files were still calling `db.query`, all in the same read/write shape, and I switched each to `db.execute({ sql, params })` to match the rest of the codebase.

One spot still uses `db.query`: `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`. Its own header says it's a vendored file, replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so I left it alone. Worth a shim or an upstream fix if that call site matters.
